refusals.free_commit_bytes: resource_guard:critical:free_commit_bytes: Not starting a new terminal session: the host lane has 1.00 GiB of free commit, below the 1.50 GiB critical floor. Free memory (close a build or a session) and try again, or start anyway to override. The limits live in Settings > Resource Guard.
refusals.thread_count: resource_guard:critical:thread_count: Not starting a new terminal session: the runner process is carrying 540 threads, above the 400-thread critical ceiling.
